section_title: Basic flat-roof envelopes for certain districts - R3-2/R4/R4B statements

verbatim_excerpt:
R3-2 R4 R4B R5 R5B R5D

In the districts indicated, the height and setback regulations for buildings or other structures shall be set forth in this Section.

R3-2 R4
In the districts indicated, for residences not subject to the provisions of Section 23-421, the maximum building height shall be 35 feet.

R4B
In the district indicated, the maximum building height shall be 25 feet.

rows.condition: residences NOT subject to the provisions of Section 23-421 (i.e. not the detached / semi-detached / zero-lot-line pitched forms)
rows.base_height_setback: none stated (single flat building-height cap; no base-height/setback split)

rows.condition: unconditional within this Section (R4B has no Section 23-421 pitched counterpart)
rows.base_height_setback: none stated (single flat building-height cap; no base-height/setback split)

table.table_note: The R5/R5B/R5D statements of this same section are captured separately in snapshot zr-23-422 for the accepted M4-T006 R5 pilot and are intentionally NOT duplicated here. R3-2 and R4 also appear in Section 23-421 (pitched) - the section is selected by building type; the two envelopes are distinct and must never be conflated. R4B appears ONLY here (flat-only); the asymmetry is recorded, not symmetrized.

district_enumeration.anchor: 23-422 opening district list (first line of the section body) and the per-statement district labels
district_enumeration.note: R3-2 and R4 receive a 35 ft maximum building height for residences NOT subject to Section 23-421; R4B receives a 25 ft maximum building height. R3A, R3X, R3-1, R4-1 and R4A do NOT appear in Section 23-422 (they are pitched-only under 23-421) - recorded, not symmetrized.

notes: Governs the flat-roof envelope for R3-2/R4 (35 ft max building height, for residences not subject to 23-421) and R4B (25 ft max building height). Each is a single maximum-building-height cap with NO base-height/setback split - a base height and a setback are not invented.

R3-2 and R4 have BOTH a pitched envelope (23-421: 25 ft perimeter / 35 ft ridge) and this flat envelope (35 ft building height); the section is selected by building type. R4B is flat-only. The R3-2/R4 flat 35 ft cap is a DIFFERENT construct from R4B's 25 ft cap and from the 23-421 pitched 25/35 caps - encoded separately, never inherited.
